mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.5 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1500.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 112.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which signals an impending economic slowdown and reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO falls below 112.0, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals strong aggregate demand, which raises inflation expectations and triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, suppressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their thresholds, or the joint signal fails to produce a significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that erode real returns and increase equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when CPIAUCSL exceeds 203.5 and FEDFUNDS is ≤5.5%, or the joint signal does not produce a significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment above 137,500 thousand signals strong labor market demand, which drives wage growth and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 137,500, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures above 365,000 million dollars signals robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenues and earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 365,000, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
